verses.text: When Joshua was old and had lived many years, the LORD said to him, "You are now very old, and there is still a great deal of land left to be taken.
This is the land that is left: all the regions of the Philistines and the Geshurites,

from the Shihor River on the border of Egypt north to the border of Ekron, which is counted as Canaanite land. It includes the land of the five Philistine rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron, and the land of the Avvites
in the south. It also includes all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah, which belongs to the Sidonians, as far as Aphek and the border of the Amorites,
and the land of the people of Gebal, and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

As for all the people of the mountains from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, all the Sidonians, I myself will drive them out ahead of the Israelites. Be sure to give this land to Israel as their own, as I have told you.
So now divide this land among the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh as their own."
The other half of Manasseh, with the tribes of Reuben and Gad, had already received the land Moses gave them east of the Jordan. Moses, the servant of the LORD, had given it to them.
It stretched from Aroer on the edge of the Arnon Valley, and from the town in the middle of the valley, and included the whole plain of Medeba as far as Dibon,
and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, up to the border of the Ammonites.
It also included Gilead, the land of the people of Geshur and Maakah, all of Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salekah,
the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had ruled in Ashtaroth and Edrei. He was one of the last of the Rephaites. Moses had defeated them and driven them out.
But the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maakah, so they still live among the Israelites today.
But Moses gave no land to the tribe of Levi. The food offerings burned to the LORD, the God of Israel, are their share, as he promised them.
This is what Moses gave to the tribe of Reuben, clan by clan:
Their land stretched from Aroer on the edge of the Arnon Valley, and the town in the middle of the valley, and the whole plain past Medeba,
to Heshbon and all its towns on the plain, including Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley,
Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth.

It included all the towns on the plain and the whole kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon. Moses had defeated him and the leaders of Midian: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba, princes who lived in the land and served Sihon.
Among those killed, the Israelites also killed with the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practised fortune-telling.
The western border of Reuben was the Jordan River. These towns and their villages were the land given to the tribe of Reuben, clan by clan.
This is what Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, clan by clan:
Their land included Jazer, all the towns of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer, near Rabbah.
It stretched from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir.

In the valley it included Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Sukkoth and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon. Its western border was the Jordan, as far as the end of the Sea of Galilee, east of the Jordan.
These towns and their villages were the land given to the tribe of Gad, clan by clan.
This is what Moses gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh, clan by clan:
Their land stretched from Mahanaim and included all of Bashan, the whole kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns.
Half of Gilead, with Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of Og in Bashan, was given to the descendants of Makir son of Manasseh, for half of Makir's descendants, clan by clan.
This is how Moses divided the land when he was on the plains of Moab, across the Jordan east of Jericho.
But Moses gave no land to the tribe of Levi. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their share, as he promised them.
